reason: Reviewed all shipped guidance surfaces. QR-first setup uses the existing qrcode library to show a scannable terminal QR for noninteractive text output and preserves the interactive terminal renderer. Structured setup exposes an owner-only text artifact alongside the PNG so a text-only harness can present the QR verbatim before requesting a scan or a result. Both artifacts resolve the same trusted approval proof and are removed on resolution/logout. Shipped skill and harness instructions require visible QR presentation before User action; an image path alone is insufficient. Browser and invitation selection, exact pairing resumption, lifecycle hooks, naming, domain terms, trust authority and acknowledgement duties are unchanged. QR/proof media remain local and never enter Notification Requests.
